description:
Based on the affiliate program details shown in your image and NextEvo's brand information, here's how I'd fill out that affiliate listing:

About our brand and products:

NextEvo Naturals is a premium CBD wellness company founded by former Johnson & Johnson executives with 25+ years in healthcare and CPG. We specialize in science-backed CBD solutions featuring our proprietary SmartSorb™ Technology that delivers 6x better absorption than traditional oil-based CBD products. Our product line includes CBD gummies, dissolvable powders, clinical-strength creams (up to 5% concentration), tablets, and wellness complexes targeting pain relief, sleep, stress, and recovery. All products are made from US-grown hemp, THC-free, vegan, non-GMO, and third-party lab tested with clinical validation from medical professionals.

What makes us different:

  • SmartSorb™ Technology: 6x better absorption and 40x faster onset than oil-based competitors
  • Clinical backing: Led by Dr. David Chernoff with published research and clinical trials
  • Highest concentration cream: 5% CBD (5000mg) - industry-leading potency at $0.0098/mg
  • Professional partnerships: Official partner with Philadelphia PGA Section
  • Premium positioning: Founded by former J&J executives, manufactured in GMP-certified, FDA-inspected facilities
  • Proven results: Already trusted by athletes, golf pros, and wellness enthusiasts

How affiliates can earn:

  • 15% commission per order with 30-day cookie duration
  • Auto-discount applied for customers (30% off first order)
  • PayPal payments for easy commission processing
  • Auto-approval system for quick onboarding
  • Available in: Australia, United Kingdom, United States
  • Promotion options: Affiliate links and coupon codes

How to promote us:

  • Target active adults 30-50+ seeking natural pain relief and wellness solutions
  • Focus on golf, tennis, fitness, and recovery communities
  • Highlight our clinical strength and superior absorption technology
  • Emphasize professional partnerships and scientific backing
  • Use our tagline "Play The Game. Leave The Pain" in content
  • Promote our starter bundles and subscription options (20% ongoing discount)
  • Leverage seasonal campaigns and sports-related content

Other information:

  • Free shipping on orders over $70
  • Subscription program with 20% ongoing savings
  • Age restriction: 18+ 
  • Peak seasons: Q1/Q4 with higher demand in winter/spring
  • Marketing support: We provide affiliate resources and can discuss co-marketing opportunities
  • Target AOV: $95 for single purchases, $220 for subscription customers
  • Customer retention: Average 3 orders per subscription customer

This positions NextEvo as a premium, science-backed brand perfect for affiliates targeting health-conscious, active adults seeking effective natural wellness solutions!
name: NextEvo Naturals
